'''Flight Corridor 17''' was the flight corridor on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] where [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[TIE Advanced x1/Legends|TIE Advanced x1]] was stored before its usage in the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].
